jobs.title: Hiring - Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in financial analytics, Finance MIS, internal audit, or internal controls.
* Practical experience in Power BI dashboards, advanced Excel, and ERP reporting.
* Good understanding of accounting processes, internal controls, risk assessments, and financial reporting.
* Experience in FMCG, distribution, trading, or multi-entity organisations preferred.
* Exposure to internal audit testing, process reviews, and SOP compliance assessments will be an advantage.

**Educational Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related discipline.
* ACCA, CMA, CIMA, CIA, or equivalent professional qualifications will be an advantage.
* Certification in Power BI, SQL, Data Analytics, or Internal Auditing will be preferred.
